crossRefs.note: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?
Hear this, you elders, And listen, all you inhabitants of the land. Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days…
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on…
and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge…
for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

translations.web: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
translations.bsb: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
translations.kjv: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
translations.asv: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud; for Jehovah hath spoken.
